body.definition: According to the definitions of the American and British Thoracic Societies, including pulmonary functional tests, X-rays, and CT scans for items such as fibrosis, bronchiectasis, bullae, emphysema, nodular or lymphomatous abnormalities.
body.name: Chronic lung disease

translations.definition: Podle definic the American and British Thoracic Societies, včetně plicních funkčních testů, rentgenových snímků a CT vyšetření pro položky jako fibróza, bronchiektázie, bulky, emfyzém, uzlovité nebo lymfomatózní abnormality
translations.name: Chronické onemocnění plic

translations.definition: Amerikan ve İngiliz Thoacic Derneklerinin tanımlamalarına göre Pulmoner fonksiyonel testler, X-ışınları ve fibroz, bronşektazi, bül, amfizem, nodüler veya lenfomatöz anormallikler gibi maddelerin taranması da dahil olmak üzere
translations.name: Kronik akciğer hastalığı
